groups.label: What you can upload
groups.text: The resizer opens any image your browser can read:

groups.label: What you can download
groups.text: Every preset downloads as PNG or JPG.

groups.label: File size
groups.text: There's no upload limit in the resizer.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to Use the Telegram Photo Resizer

steps.title: Choose your image
steps.text: Click the upload area or drop a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF on it.

steps.title: Pick a preset
steps.text: Choose profile photo, sticker, channel post or custom emoji.

steps.title: Pick a format
steps.text: PNG keeps edges crisp and keeps transparency in fill mode.

good.label: Do
items: Use PNG for stickers, logos and text

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: Telegram Profile Picture Size and Image Sizes at a Glance
cards.quote: A Telegram profile photo works well as a square 640×640 image, which Telegram crops to a circle.
